artifacts.summary: Spec confirms the ideation's premise live: ijac has zero non-subscription Expenses rows for Jan-Apr 2026 on production (23 rows, all scheduler-generated exp-auto-). The source migration tab (a personal smoney ledger export) was characterized via the captain's own connected Drive account, since both service accounts get 403 and public export gets 401 -- 310 total rows, 203 in-window expense rows to import, 1 income row correctly excluded (no income field in the app schema), and a second unrelated 2025 data block in the same file flagged as out of scope. 15 of 17 categories map cleanly by exact name on both staging and production; 2 need the captain's ruling (房客 vs 房客支出 staging/production divergence, and 進修 with no match on either target). New id scheme exp-mig066-r{sourceRow}, collision-free against every prior entity. 13 ACs (11 offline, 2 interactive). Build cannot start its live extraction until the spreadsheet is shared with the staging service account.
